influences.context: When I was at university, I was obsessed with early 20th-century art, the Dadaists and the Surrealists

influences.name: Mark Lanegan
influences.context: I would write a simple instrumental, and then I'd hand it off to Mark Lanegan, or to Cold Specks, and they would write lyrics and vocal melodies, and they'd hand it back to me, and I'd rewrite the song based on what they'd done

influences.name: Massive Attack
influences.context: The first three or four Massive Attack records made so much sense to me – they experimented with genres, worked with different singers and tried to write beautiful songs with them.
